settingsVisibility.description: Keys name scalar block settings. Each rule uses an unconditional required sibling select with a valid default. Values are a nonempty unique subset of its options. No self references, chains or cycles; validation is unconditional.

FieldDefinition.description: Finite descriptors: at most six group/list containers, two consecutive groups, and no direct list of lists. Content has at most 100 items/list and 500 list elements/snapshot. Shared runtime validation also enforces ordered length/range bounds, defaults conforming to their descriptors, select presentation matching unique options, and layout references to distinct immediate siblings.

FieldVisibility.description: Conditional fields. Keys name immediate sibling fields; each rule names a sibling select or boolean controller that is not itself a target, and a nonempty unique subset of its options or booleans. A hidden field is not required, keeps draft validation and is retained in drafts; its value is omitted from published snapshots, public reads and build exports.

FormLayout.description: Groups place distinct immediate sibling fields. Keys are unique; references and composite depth are checked by shared runtime validation.

itemLabel.description: Immediate text, textarea, select, url child of a group item; presentation only.

SelectPresentation.description: Exactly one choice per declared option. Labels/descriptions are nonempty plain text; cells must not overlap.

items.description: Integer rectangle contained in a 12 by 12 canvas; no overlaps.

parameters.description: JSON array, at most 8192 UTF-8 bytes and 16 distinct field conditions. Strict objects carry field and op. All types: isSet/isNotSet with no operands; text/textarea/url: eq or contains with value (1–200 UTF-16 units, literal ASCII-insensitive/non-ASCII-sensitive); boolean: eq with boolean value; number: eq with finite value or range with inclusive optional min/max; select: in with 1–50 distinct configured strings in values (OR); date/datetime: range with inclusive optional from/to (YYYY-MM-DD or explicit-offset ISO instants normalized to UTC). A range needs at least one bound and cannot be inverted. Different fields combine with AND. Missing/null/empty strings are unset; false and zero are present. Only configured draft fields are supported. contains uses ordinary literal LIKE with ESCAPE: Node 200 code units; Cloudflare 48 code units and 50 UTF-8 bytes after escaping percent, underscore and backslash and adding substring wrappers. Text eq uses = COLLATE NOCASE without a pattern budget. Only ASCII case is ignored. Omission or [] means no filters.

Custom string sorts use current-draft/revision anchors: a successful boundary-draft save, deletion or replacement expires the anchor. Invalid or stale continuations return value-free 422 at /after, even for an empty next page. Restart without after while retaining the query.
